en.headline: Fanling water main burst cuts supply at Cheung Wah Estate
en.dek: A 200-millimetre fresh-water pipe near the estate entrance flooded San Wan Road on Wednesday night; the Water Supplies Department said service was restored from about 1.30am.
body: A fresh-water main burst at the junction of San Wan Road and Fanling Station Road near Cheung Wah Estate on Wednesday night, sending muddy water across the carriageway and interrupting both drinking and flushing supply to the estate.

Police were called at about 10pm. Officers found water about a foot deep over an area of roughly 20 metres by 20 metres, with some flow reaching the estate. Vehicles had to drive through the water and a KMB bus was briefly stranded, local reports said.

The Water Supplies Department said on its public channel that the leaking pipe was a 200-millimetre main serving Cheung Wah Estate. After the valves were shut, flooding stopped. The department placed two water wagons and 20 tanks nearby, sent a supply team to households that needed water, and coordinated with the estate management office, the Housing Department and the North District Office.

Engineers completed a supply diversion and the department said fresh and flushing water at Cheung Wah Estate was gradually restored from about 1.30am on Thursday. Repair work on the damaged pipe was continuing.

zh.headline: 粉嶺新運路食水管爆裂 祥華邸一度停水
zh.dek: 周三晚祥華邸入口附近一條直徑200毫米食水管爆裂，黃泥水湧上路面；水務署稱食水及沖廁水今晨約1時半起陸續恢復。
body: 粉嶺新運路與粉嶺車站路交界、近祥華邸入口周三晚上發生食水管爆裂，黃泥水湧上路面，祥華邸食水及沖廁水一度受影響。
警方晚上約10時接報到場，發現現場水深約一呎，受影響範圍約20米乘\u20米，部分泥水流入屋邸。途經車輛須涉水而行，有九巴一度受阻。
水務署在社交平台表示，涉事為一條直徑200毫米的食水供水管，負責供應祥華邸食水及沖廁水。關上水掸後現場停止湧水。署方放置兩架水車及20個水箱供居民取水，並派出供水隊伍為有需要住戶送水，同時與屋邸管理處、房屋署及北區民政事務處協調。
署方其後表示，工程團隊完成供水調度後，祥華邸食水及沖廁水已於周四凌晨約1時半起陸續恢復正常，損壞水管仍在搶修。
